title: Ripfumelo Leri Nga Endzhaku Ka Xiluvelo
intro: Mimoya-xiviri yin’wana a yi ringiwi hi ndzilo kumbe ndhambi, kambe hi ntshikilelo lowu nonokaka wa ku hanya endzeni ka xigodlho xa mufumi wa tihanyi. Xifaniso lexi a xi yime etlhelo ka mufumi loyi a a vula leswaku i vukwembu ehenhla ka vanhu va vona, kambe exihundleni a a namarhela ripfumelo eka Xikwembu Xin’we xa Ntiyiso. Loko ku tinyiketela ka vona ku tshuburiwile, ku xaniseka ku tile — kambe ku ve na xitshembiso xa Xikwembu. Xana u nga swi kota ku ringanyeta leswaku loyi i mani?
clues: A ndzi tshama ehansi ka lwangu ra mufumi wa matimba swinene wa tiko ra ka hina, eka xiyimo lexi a hi vangani lava a va ta xi ehleketa.
Mutekiwa wa mina u yime emahlweni ka vanhu kutani a tivula xikwembu — kambe mbilu ya mina a yi ri ya Hosi Yin’we ya Ntiyiso.
A ndzi hlevetela swikhongelo exihundleni, ndzi chava nxupulo lowu a wu ta eka hinkwavo lava a va kaneta munghana wa mina wa vukati.
Loko ripfumelo ra mina ri paluxiwa, ndzi khomiwile ndzi xanisiwa — hambiswiritano ririmi ra mina a ri si tshama ri vula rito ro pfumala ku pfumela.
Ndzi chululele mbilu ya mina eka Hosi ya mina, ndzi kombela yindlu eParadeyisini, ekule na swiendlo hinkwaswo swo biha.
Mina ndzi Asiya bint Muzahim — nsati wa Faro loyi a kaneteke Musa na Harun.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Nsati wa Faro) .
Hawwa (Evha), wansati wo sungula
Sara, nsati wo sungula wa Ibrahim
Agara, mana wa Isimayili
Mana wa Maryam (nsati wa Imran) .

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku tiyisela ku xanisiwa hikwalaho ko ala ku landzula ripfumelo
Ku pona endzeni ka khwiri ra nhlampfi leyikulu
Ku aka ngalava leyikulu leswaku ku balekela ndhambi
Ku hoxiwa endzilweni lowu pfurhaka
Ku vona ku hambana ka lwandle lerikulu
trial.answer: Ku tiyisela ku xanisiwa hikwalaho ko ala ku landzula ripfumelo

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Yindlu leyi va akeriweke yona eParadeyisini
Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka
Ngalava leyi rhwaleke mimpatswa ya xivumbiwa xin’wana ni xin’wana
Rhole ra nsuku leri gandzeriwaka hi tiko
Xigwitsirisi lexi a xi tirhisiwa ku hlula nhenha leyikulu
location.answer: Yindlu leyi va akeriweke yona eParadeyisini

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ku xiximiwa hi ku tshama eParadeyisini etlhelo ka lavo lulama
Va nwele ehansi ka magandlati swin’we ni vuthu ra vona
Yi hisiwile hi malangavi kambe yi ponisiwile hi ku nghenelela ka Xikwembu
Yi mitiwa hi xivumbiwa lexikulu kutani yi lahleriwa eribuweni
U ve munhu la fuweke swinene enkarhini wa vona
outcome.answer: Ku xiximiwa hi ku tshama eParadeyisini etlhelo ka lavo lulama

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
